correctness.rationale: After quotienting by the first character, Haar pushforward reduces the problem exactly to a root-of-unity average (or circle Haar average for infinite order). The normalized moment is a polynomial in the magnitude parameter whose coefficients are nonnegative after phase alignment; its strictly positive quadratic coefficient forces equal magnitudes. Root-of-unity filtering gives the binomial congruence sum. Equality in the phase comparison is automatic above the aliasing threshold and, below it, the positive q-th harmonic forces and is forced by q times the relative phase being an integer multiple of 2π. The argument covers all q and h in the stated domain; the checker only corroborates exact identities on finite ranges.
